outcome_evidence: The oven door is initially closed (frame 0, image and left_ego_image). The robot approaches the upper door/handle area, then pulls the door outward: frames 96–110 in image show the door separating from the housing and tilting outward, corroborated by left_ego_image. The door remains visibly ajar at frame 180 in image and left_ego_image. It is not opened fully horizontal, but the requested opening is achieved; no failed acquisition, unwanted collision, or displaced unrelated object is established.
